idea-plugin.name: FlatBars
idea-plugin.description:
Syntax support for FlatBars templates (and the Handlebars / Mustache surfaces it covers), implementing the two-layer model of ADR-017:
  • A TextMate grammar (the floor) colours the default-delimiter forms everywhere — including Community IDEs and before the server attaches.
  • flatbars-lsp semantic tokens (the ceiling), on IntelliJ Ultimate (2024.2+), run the actual engine lexer and override the grammar, correcting the stateful regions (set delimiters, dialects, MaxBars operators) a grammar cannot track. The engine always wins where it runs. (Built with -PwithLsp.)

Supports every JetBrains IDE (TextMate floor) and IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate 2024.2+ (LSP ceiling — semantic tokens, diagnostics, hover, completion, canonicalisation quick-fix, structure view, code folding, formatting).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 (2026-06-04)

  • First public release.
  • TextMate fallback (every JetBrains IDE) and Ultimate-only LSP ceiling (IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate 2024.2+).
  • Native extensions per dialect — long (.rawbars / .minbars / .classicbars / .maxbars) and short (.rbars / .mbars / .fbars / .xbars); MaxBars also claims .truss (Trussbars AOT-compiled templates).
  • Helper-name highlighting from the prelude catalogue; canonicalisation quick-fix on deprecated aliases.
  • Hybrid-template injection grammar — *.host.flatbars-ext files paint both the host syntax and the FlatBars tags (set the file association in IDE Settings → Editor → File Types).
  • Live Templates: if, ifelse, each, eachas, with, unless, let, partial, comment, rawblock.
  • Tools ▸ FlatBars action group: Open in Lab, Show Helper Catalogue, Report Issue.
  • Community-edition users keep the TextMate floor; an EditorNotifications banner explains the Ultimate-only LSP capabilities.
  • See ADR-026 for the full LSP capability matrix (what we ship and what we deliberately do not, with rationale).
